FX.title: [USD/JPY] UP: Price Above MA20 with Bullish Momentum Amid Mixed Fed/Oil Signals
tldr_points: Price holds above MA20 indicating short-term bullish bias.
RSI near 66 suggests room for further upside before overbought.
Fed tightening potential and rising crude oil support USD demand.
FX.excerpt: USD/JPY trades above MA20 with RSI 66, suggesting upside potential amid Fed tightening hopes and higher oil.
FX.comment: Price above MA20 with bullish RSI and supportive fundamentals from oil and Fed tightening prospects.
